plan: I will maintain a focus on building a strong economy until Cycle 5, aiming for 11 Crypto with high-value cards like Kilo-Coin and Mega-Cache. I will pivot to Chaos starting in Cycle 6, emphasizing Drain strategies and integrating Restore cards for defense. By Cycle 12, I will aggressively acquire VP cards, adapting my strategy based on the opponent's moves and the influence of new Locations like 'The Nudge' that rewards early VP acquisition. (Schedule: economy through Cycle 5, Chaos from Cycle 6, VP from Cycle 10.)

theories.text: Shyte-Coin is not worth a deck slot: it dilutes draws. Bigger Crypto (Kilo, Mega-Cache) or Characters that draw cards are better buys.
Buying a few high-value Crypto cards (cost 6+) by Cycle 5 builds the economy that wins the late game.
Characters that draw cards cycle the deck back to its best cards faster than extra Crypto does.
